description: This file defines an abstract PHP controller class 'AbstractInstallerVueController' used for managing installation and upgrade screens in a web-based installer process for the OrangeHRM system. It handles rendering Vue.js components, managing templates, and controlling the flow of different installation steps.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerVueController
classes.description: An abstract controller class that provides mechanisms for rendering installer or upgrader Vue.js-based UI steps, managing templates, and maintaining context during the installation process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Twig environment with template directories and sets default context.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig Environment instance used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns a Vue Component object to be used in rendering.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Returns the current Vue Component object.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Provides access to the AttributeBag that holds context data for rendering.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to initialize additional setup.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook method executed before rendering, can be overridden for custom logic.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Vue component inside a Twig template and returns the HTML as string.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook method executed after rendering, can be overridden for custom logic.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to process request, perform pre-render, render HTML, and prepare response.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Builds context parameters for template rendering, including component info and request data.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Retrieves asset version info or timestamp for cache busting.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Returns the current sequence of steps for installer or upgrader based on application state.

methods.name: getCurrentStep
methods.description: Calculates the current step index in the sequence of installer/upgrader screens.
